name: curl
description: Command line tool and library for transferring files using URL syntax.
install: cd curl-8.18.0 && rm -rf docs/examples/.deps && find docs \( -name Makefile\* -o -name \*.1 -o -name \*.3 -o -name CMakeLists.txt \) -delete && mkdir -p $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/curl-8.18.0 && cp -v -R docs/* $DESTDIR/usr/share/doc/curl-8.18.0/
